blocks.raw: <Tip>Memory aid: "Silicone = Class 50+ (±50%), 20+ years service life. Polyurethane = Class 50 (±50%), 15-20 years, moisture-curing. Acrylic = Class 7.5 (±7.5%), 10-15 years, water-based, rain-sensitive. Joint width = 2 × movement. Epoxy = adhesive (permanent); Polyurethane = sealant (flexible)."</Tip>

blocks.raw: <WikiMistakeCard mistake="Specifying acrylic sealant for a facade joint in the Philippines without considering that it is water-based and rain will wash it away during cure." correction="Acrylic sealants require 24-48 hours dry cure; installing during or immediately before monsoon (May-November) results in failure. Use polyurethane or silicone sealants that are moisture-tolerant." />
